description: This file defines several OpenERP/Odoo models related to reporting on tasks, user pipelines, closed tasks, and timesheets, including SQL view initialization.

classes.name: report_task_user_pipeline_open
classes.description: Model for reporting tasks by user and project, with a SQL view for aggregated data.

classes.name: report_closed_task
classes.description: Model for reporting recently closed tasks, with a SQL view filtering by close date.

classes.name: report_timesheet_task_user
classes.description: Model for reporting task and timesheet hours per user, with functions to compute hours.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes SQL views for each report model.

methods.name: _get_task_hours
methods.description: Calculates total task hours for a user within a month.

methods.name: get_hrs_timesheet
methods.description: Calculates total timesheet hours for a user within a month.
